# The IEM card's ARC replies to netaudio's page read (start code 0x27ff,
# body 00 01 <first item> 00 00), captured from the real card on 2026-10-26
# (#72): one line a reply, <op1> <first item> <the whole reply datagram in
# hex, header included>. Scrubbed for P6: each channel's own name (0x2010)
# replaced by a synthetic one of the same byte length ("Name NN" padded with
# underscores), and the 0x2010 channel ids by synthetic ones (which channels
# carry names is site data); every offset, count, flag, length, status and
# sequence byte kept. The default names (0x2000) are the card's channel
# numbers, zero-padded, as on every such card: kept. No reply holds the
# device's name or an address.

0x1000 97 27ff002c51041000000107f90080008000180008001000200020010000020002000000000000000000000000
